title: Area config
description: areas/<name>/area.yaml, schema_version 2, as pipeline/areacfg.py loads it. `opencity new-area` writes a complete example; areas/tucson_jacome/area.yaml is a filled one. Paths may use ${ROOT} templates (${WORK}, ${DATA}, ${TOKEN_FILE}) that pipeline/areacfg.py expands.

derive.description: true: `opencity build` writes derived.yaml into the scratch dir and those values become the area's knob defaults.

license.description: public: no source marked restricted may feed the build, and `opencity publish` refuses a public tag when one did.

name.description: Used in work, scratch and publish dir names.

bbox_wsen.description: Model extent, W, S, E, N (common.BBOX_WSEN).

fetch_bbox_wsen.description: Box passed to the fetch tools; default bbox_wsen.

origin.description: ENU origin (common.ORIGIN). Every metre coordinate of the build is relative to it.

origin_provisional.description: true until `pipeline/nomesh.py manifest` sets alt_m from the lidar ground.

crs_epsg.description: UTM zone of the box; the NAIP ortho is fetched in it.

timezone.description: IANA zone; s19_delight reads Mapillary capture times in it.

paths.description: scratch_dir marks an area build. The upper-case keys override the matching common.py paths.

publish_name.description: Dir name under OPENCITY_PUBLISH; may not start with '_'.

sources.description: Local first, national fallback. Each input lists the local sources that cover the box and the fallback every stage can run on alone. A source block with `restricted: true` has terms that forbid redistribution or sale.

mapillary.description: token_file is a PATH, never a token value; max_panos, pano_spacing_m, licence.

ortho.description: primary: naip, or the name of a local ortho whose tiles and source.json are placed in <scratch_dir>/ortho by hand.

trees.description: city: a pipeline/city_trees.py CITIES name, or none; default picked from the box.

city_props.description: A pipeline/city_props.py CITIES name (the registry ships empty; add an entry to use one), or none; default picked from the box.

stage_knobs.description: Knobs that live in stage modules.
